text:
alex: Heads-up: we need a tiny customer-facing 'post-go-live stabilization' note for accounts that had a spike. Focus: cache tuning, batching guards, streaming fallbacks, quick telemetry queries, and a compact renewal-health pulse. Needs to be copy-paste ready for customers and a short 48h CS checklist.

dina: I can draft. Aim for a one-paragraph customer note + a 48h CS rep checklist. Include exact headers, SDK hints, and an actionable SQL snippet.

haruto: Add a 10-minute quick-check list for the field engineer on duty (super fast). Also include how to request temporary extra capacity (who to ping).

dina: Draft customer-facing paragraph (short):
"""
Post-go-live stabilization: To minimize token waste and keep interactive latency low after spikes, we recommend (1) a short shared cache for repeat prompts (20-40s), (2) conservative client-side batching with a latency guard, and (3) streaming for interactive routes with a polling fallback. If latency or errors rise, follow the rollback plays: pin to the previous model, halve batch tokens, and temporarily disable streaming on affected endpoints. For immediate capacity, email capacity@redwood with subject "Burst Request: <tenant>".
"""

dina: Customer copy-paste headers (for CDN/proxy):
```http
Cache-Control: public, max-age=30, stale-while-revalidate=45
X-Redwood-Tenant: cust_3501
```

haruto: SDK guard examples to include (different from other threads):
```py
# python client hint: apply a latency SLO and a safety cap
client.generate(..., batch_policy={"max_batch_tokens":"600", "latency_slo_ms":"120", "safety_cap_tokens":"1200"})
```

dina: JS example for toggling streaming fallback logic:
```js
const res = await client.generate({stream: true});
res.on('chunk', handleChunk);
res.on('error', async (err) => {
  // fallback to polling
  for (let i=0;i<30;i++){
    await sleep(1000);
    const p = await client.pollStatus();
    if (p.ready) break;
  }
});
```

haruto: 10-minute field quick-check (run on call):
- confirm API key validity and model pin
- run 3 smoke calls (short, mid, long) and note latencies
- check error rate in last 10m (>1% 5xx?)
- confirm shared cache header is present on repeat traffic

dina: SQL telemetry snippet (hourly & 10m):
```sql
-- hourly
SELECT count(*) AS reqs, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95, sum(case when status>=500 then 1 else 0 end) AS s5xx
FROM requests
WHERE tenant='cust_3501' AND ts > now() - interval '1 hour';

-- last 10 minutes
SELECT count(*) AS reqs_10m, sum(case when status>=500 then 1 else 0 end) AS s5xx_10m
FROM requests
WHERE tenant='cust_3501' AND ts > now() - interval '10 minutes';
```

haruto: Renewal-health pulse (console-friendly): provide a simple JSON-like map customers can display (we'll render it server-side):
```text
{"health_score":1, "notes":"Watch: p95 latency slightly above target; streaming errors intermittent"}
```

dina: CS rep 48h checklist (step-by-step):
- 0-1h: Validate keys & model pin, run smoke calls and capture latencies.
- 1-6h: Enable/confirm shared cache (30s), start 10-minute snapshots for first 6h, watch 5xx>1% alerts.
- 6-18h: If median or p95 latency > SLA, reduce batch tokens by 30% and lower maxWaitMs; validate streaming UX end-to-end.
- 18-48h: Compute renewal-health pulse daily; collect qualitative feedback and raise a follow-up if score >=2.

alex: Add rollback plays clearly in the one-pager: pin model, halve batch tokens, switch impacted endpoints to polling.

haruto: Capacity request reminder: capacity@redwood (cc ops). For >10x expected burst require 24h lead.

ops-bot: Auto-note: attach runbook to /confluence/cs/post-go-live and add tag 'burst-stabilization'.

dina: I'll compress this into a one-pager PDF for customers and a short CS play checklist. Posting to #cs-assets tonight.

alex: Great — thanks. Keep the one-pager under 250 words. :rocket:
